items.Sentence: The WWTF features secondary treatment and consists of a wet well with a grinder, two lift pumps, an aeration basin, clarifier, six evaporation/percolation ponds, emergency basin, two concrete lined sludge drying beds, and surrounding bermed land owned by the District which has been utilized for discharge in the past during pond maintenance activities.
